title: SOC 2 Type II Certification
content: Our platform is audited annually by an independent AICPA-accredited firm and maintains an active SOC 2 Type II report covering Security, Confidentiality, and Availability.

title: ISO 27001:2022 Certification
content: We hold global ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification for our Information Security Management System (ISMS), audited by BSI.

title: Data Encryption Standards
content: All customer data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256 with envelope encryption managed via cloud KMS with automatic annual key rotation.

title: Identity, SSO, and SCIM Provisioning
content: Enterprise SSO is supported natively via SAML 2.0 and OIDC. Automated user lifecycle management is supported through SCIM 2.0.

title: Cloud Multi-Tenant Architecture & Isolation
content: The platform runs on AWS and Azure across multiple availability zones using containerized Kubernetes clusters with high availability.

title: Developer REST APIs and Webhooks
content: We provide comprehensive OpenAPI 3.1 REST APIs alongside HMAC-signed real-time webhooks for audit and security logs.

title: High Availability and Service Level Agreement
content: Enterprise tier guarantees 99.99% monthly service uptime backed by financial SLA credits. Recovery Point Objective (RPO) is under 5 minutes; Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is under 1 hour.

title: Data Privacy and GDPR/CCPA Compliance
content: We act as a Data Processor under GDPR and Service Provider under CCPA/CPRA. Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and a comprehensive Data Processing Addendum (DPA) are executed with all enterprise clients.
